about: Questions for ./scripts/ask-eval, about this repository's own model (Dependinator.sln, as the dev host opens it). Each case is one conversation: its questions are asked in turn, later ones as follow-ups. An answer passes when every 'nodes' entry names a node the answer lists or links (alternatives split by |, matched on the name's last parts) and 'text' (a case-insensitive regex) matches its text. Keep the expectations to facts that stay true as the code changes, and update them when a name moves.
